item.title: J&K High Court raps IIT Jammu for arbitrary cancellation, orders appointment of candidate
item.description: WAJAHAT SHABIR SRINAGAR: The High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh has set aside the cancellation of candidature of a Srinagar-based engineer for the post of Laboratory Officer (Material Science Engineering) at IIT Jammu, holding that the institute acted without lawful justification despite the candidate possessing the requisite experience and having cleared the selection process. item.title: Special NIA court orders attachment of property of US-based Kashmiri lobbyist
item.description: Srinagar: A special NIA court in Jammu and Kashmir on Tuesday ordered immediate attachment of land belonging to Ghulam Nabi Fai, a US-based Kashmiri lobbyist and convicted agent of Pakistan’s Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI). National Investigation Agency (NIA) Special Judge Yahaya Firdous of Budgam district authorised the seizure of over 1.5 kanals (approximately 8,100 sq. ft.) of land across two villages — Wadwan and Chattabugh. item.title: 24×7 surveillance on Vaishno Devi track ahead of New Year
item.description: Jammu: Surveillance has been stepped up along the route to the Mata Vaishno Devi shrine atop Trikuta hills in Jammu and Kashmir’s Reasi to manage the expected New Year pilgrim rush, with focus on high-footfall and congested stretches, officials said on Tuesday. item.title: Bangladesh: protests Rohingya settlements spark security concerns in Jammu
item.description: SUMIT SHARMA Jammu: The issue of illegal Rohingya settlements in Jammu has come under the spotlight following protests against attacks on Hindus in Bangladesh. item.title: HC junks Mehbooba Mufti’s PIL on undertrial transfers
item.description: Jammu: The Jammu and Kashmir High Court has junked a Public Interest Litigation filed by PDP president and former chief minister Mehbooba Mufti seeking blanket directions for shifting all J&K undertrial prisoners lodged in jails outside the Union Territory, holding that the plea was vague, unsupported by material facts and carried clear political undercurrents. item.title: Advocate general’s post vacant in J&K; no proposal yet for new appointment
item.description: Jammu: The advocate general’s post in Jammu and Kashmir is lying vacant for more than a year following senior advocate D C Raina’s resignation, the Department of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs has said. item.title: Two Kashmir residents held for espionage activities in Arunachal
item.description: Itanagar: The Itanagar Police has arrested two persons from Jammu and Kashmir for alleged espionage activities in Arunachal Pradesh, an officer said on Tuesday. Inspector General of Police (Law and Order) Chukhu Apa said the two persons were arrested from Kupwara district of Jammu and Kashmir on December 18, and they have been brought to the state, where they are currently in police custody. item.title: Rajnath Singh releases BRO DPR guide to boost border road projects
item.description: Jammu: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh on Tuesday released a new Border Roads Organisation (BRO) manual designed to streamline the preparation of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) for road infrastructure projects, a move expected to significantly strengthen strategic connectivity in border regions including Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. item.title: Pulwama Man found Dead inside Srinagar Houseboat
item.description: Srinagar, Dec 25: A man from Pulwama district was found dead inside a houseboat in the Amira Kadal area of Srinagar on Thursday morning, officials said. An official said that the body of the man was found inside a houseboat moored along the Jhelum River at Amira Kadal under mysterious circumstances. item.title: Srinagar Accident leaves Motorcyclist critically injured
item.description: Srinagar, Dec 25: A motorcyclist was critically injured in a road accident in Hyderpora area of Srinagar on Thursday after his motorcycle was struck by an unknown vehicle, officials said. Officials stated that the injured sustained multiple injuries and was immediately rushed to SMHS Hospital, Srinagar, where his condition remains critical.
